entries.en: Good evening, Night City. Tonight's main story – what's next for Arasaka? How will the Japanese megacorp emerge from this crisis?
entries.ro: Bună seara, Night City. Subiectul principal de diseară – ce urmează pentru Arasaka? Cum o să iasă megacorporația japoneză din criza asta?

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="皆さん、ご苦労感謝する" t="Good day, everyone. Welcome." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="皆さん、ご苦労感謝する" t="Bună ziua, tuturor. Bun venit." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="なぜなら、アラサカはただの一企業ではないからだ" t="That is because Arasaka is more than just a corporation." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="なぜなら、アラサカはただの一企業ではないからだ" t="Asta pentru că Arasaka e mai mult decât o corporație." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: The company was recently shocked by a series of disastrous events – the most significant of which being an attack on their corporate headquarters last night.
entries.ro: Compania a fost zguduită recent de o serie de evenimente dezastruoase – cel mai grav fiind atacul de aseară asupra sediului central.

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="どうも我々の敵は、アラサカを潰せると考えたらしい" t="It seems our enemies believed Arasaka could be destroyed." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="どうも我々の敵は、アラサカを潰せると考えたらしい" t="Se pare că dușmanii noștri credeau că Arasaka poate fi distrusă." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="だが私は、彼らにこう伝えたい… 不可能であると。太陽を消し去り、海を干上がらせるほうがまだ簡単だろう" t="But I have message for them... It cannot be done. They've a better chance to extinguish the sun, or empty the seas." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="だが私は、彼らにこう伝えたい… 不可能であると。太陽を消し去り、海を干上がらせるほうがまだ簡単だろう" t="Dar am un mesaj pentru ei... Nu se poate. Au mai multe șanse să stingă soarele sau să golească mările." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="アラサカという強大な存在は誰にも止められない。アラサカは力そのものなのだ" t="Arasaka is a force – one that cannot be stopped or slowed. Arasaka is strength." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="アラサカという強大な存在は誰にも止められない。アラサカは力そのものなのだ" t="Arasaka e o forță – una care nu poate fi oprită sau încetinită. Arasaka e putere." b="" a=""/>
